svg.title: FullChaos — corrected transparent vector logo
svg.desc: Interwoven orange, red, cyan, teal and silver ribbons. Clean, opaque Bezier shapes with native color gradients on a genuinely transparent background. No raster images, opacity masks, background fill, filters, or external resources. Soft raster cutoffs have been replaced by clean vector edges.
